research_objectives: Assess the current market size and projected growth of the AI sector in India through 2030.
Identify key industrial sectors driving AI adoption and the competitive landscape of AI startups and enterprises.
Evaluate the regulatory environment and government policy frameworks influencing AI deployment in India.
Analyze critical infrastructure challenges and human capital requirements for sustained AI growth.
